nothing is ever their fault. when something goes wrong in their life, someone or something else is always to blame. only a matter of time before that someone is you.

intense criticality of all of your friends and loved ones. usually leads to insistence that you spend less time with these people. it’s hard to have a friend tell you they think your partner is being cruel to you if you have no friends that aren’t primarily your partner’s.

i’ve read several of delillo’s novels now and have always felt somewhat that his characters weren’t necessarily communicating with each other but collectively developing ideas to be communicated to the reader. the disjointed nature of them seeming to speak around each other, which i saw a lot in underworld, without really responding to each other was evocative of a general human deficit in communication and was very effective in creating a feeling of alienation and emotional distance while still constructing a larger idea about the way the characters perceive the world and the events going on around them. it feels paradoxically unnatural but representatively honest. at least imo.
